### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

## Why settle? Create a shopping experience that’s iconic.

Build it visually: drag, drop, done.

Customizable checkout that converts: optimized one-page checkout, offering digital wallets,
one-click, BNPL, and more.

Complex products, simple experiences: every variant, bundle, and configuration. Easy for shoppers,
organized for you.

Go further when you need to: full API and code access for teams that want more.

[Explore storefront design][90][Try checkout][91]

## Connect with shoppers around the globe.

Become more discoverable: with Feedonomics Surface. Sell seamlessly on platforms like Google, Meta,
and TikTok.

Reach millions of high-intent shoppers: list on major marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and
eBay.

Enrich for discovery: optimize titles, descriptions, and metadata, so your brand shows up in search
and chat.

Go global without rebuilding: get multi-language and multi-currency. Take one storefront to every
market.

[Reach more shoppers][92][Explore promotions][93]

## Built for businesses rewriting the rules.

[Get a demo][94]

## AI is the new shopper. Be its first pick.

Help AI tell your story: enrich your catalog with context that agents need to answer shoppers’
questions naturally.

Sell inside the conversation: let shoppers buy the moment they discover your product in AI search
and chat experiences.

Build brand agents: know your catalog, customers, and policies — deployed on your store and where
you sell.

Meet Companion: an AI assistant that answers questions, surfaces insights, and handles operations
for you.

[See what's possible][95]

## B2B that moves at your speed.

Your buyer gets the right experience: account-specific pricing, products, terms, and payment
options.

Self-service for your business buyers: quotes, reorders, invoice payments, and account management —
no sales rep required.

Approvals without the slowdown: buyer roles, permissions, and workflows that don't hold up orders.

B2C speed, B2B depth: run both from one place without compromise.

[Explore B2B features][96]

## Sell your way. Get paid your way.

Choose from 20+ Embedded Payment Providers without payment fees, plus access to 130+ trusted payment
solutions.

Regulated and restricted selling: age verification, compliance flows, restricted categories — all
handled without custom dev.

Non-standard models welcome: subscriptions, hybrid B2B/DTC, complex payment flows, and no forcing a
fit.

Multiple storefronts, one system: manage brands, regions, or channels without extra effort.

[Learn about payments][97]

## Launch your store today.

## No credit card. No pressure.

##### Start for free

Create your account in minutes. No credit card, no commitment. Your free trial is your actual store
— not a staged setup.

##### Build your store

Import your products, set up your checkout, and customize your storefront. Support is available the
whole way through.

##### Go live

When you're ready, choose a plan and launch. Most stores go live within 30 days. B2B portals
typically launch in 60–90 days.

[Try for free][98]

## Build and connect your stack.

Open APIs: from out-of-the-box simplicity to fully customized experiences, build what works for you.

600+ integrations: ERP, CRM, PIM, WMS — connect the tools your operations already depend on.

Enterprise-ready: advanced permissions, multi-region support, and the foundation to grow without
hitting platform limits.

Build for tomorrow: when commerce shifts, you shift with it, not against your platform.

# From one-size-fits-all to anything you can imagine.

Any business model, any product type, any customer you choose. Grow without compromise and make your
next move.

[Try for free][88][See in action][89]
[E-commerce channels dashboard display showing localized Kitchen King storefronts for Italy and the
UK.]

## Endless solutions for every kind of brand.

Launch quickly and customize the essentials, or integrate, build, and scale

on our open platform — trusted by brands across B2C and B2B.

UPLIFT Desk

The RealReal

BMW

Sellars

Toolden

AS Colour

Mizuno

Offroad Alliance

## Why settle? Create a shopping experience that’s iconic.

Build it visually: drag, drop, done.

Customizable checkout that converts: optimized one-page checkout, offering digital wallets,
one-click, BNPL, and more.

Complex products, simple experiences: every variant, bundle, and configuration. Easy for shoppers,
organized for you.

Go further when you need to: full API and code access for teams that want more.

[Explore storefront design][90][Try checkout][91]

## Connect with shoppers around the globe.

Become more discoverable: with Feedonomics Surface. Sell seamlessly on platforms like Google, Meta,
and TikTok.

Reach millions of high-intent shoppers: list on major marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and
eBay.

Enrich for discovery: optimize titles, descriptions, and metadata, so your brand shows up in search
and chat.

Go global without rebuilding: get multi-language and multi-currency. Take one storefront to every
market.

[Reach more shoppers][92][Explore promotions][93]

## Built for businesses rewriting the rules.

[Get a demo][94]

## AI is the new shopper. Be its first pick.

Help AI tell your story: enrich your catalog with context that agents need to answer shoppers’
questions naturally.

Sell inside the conversation: let shoppers buy the moment they discover your product in AI search
and chat experiences.

Build brand agents: know your catalog, customers, and policies — deployed on your store and where
you sell.

Meet Companion: an AI assistant that answers questions, surfaces insights, and handles operations
for you.

[See what's possible][95]

## B2B that moves at your speed.

Your buyer gets the right experience: account-specific pricing, products, terms, and payment
options.

Self-service for your business buyers: quotes, reorders, invoice payments, and account management —
no sales rep required.

Approvals without the slowdown: buyer roles, permissions, and workflows that don't hold up orders.

B2C speed, B2B depth: run both from one place without compromise.

[Explore B2B features][96]

## Sell your way. Get paid your way.

Choose from 20+ Embedded Payment Providers without payment fees, plus access to 130+ trusted payment
solutions.

Regulated and restricted selling: age verification, compliance flows, restricted categories — all
handled without custom dev.

Non-standard models welcome: subscriptions, hybrid B2B/DTC, complex payment flows, and no forcing a
fit.

Multiple storefronts, one system: manage brands, regions, or channels without extra effort.

[Learn about payments][97]

## Launch your store today.

## No credit card. No pressure.

##### Start for free

Create your account in minutes. No credit card, no commitment. Your free trial is your actual store
— not a staged setup.

##### Build your store

Import your products, set up your checkout, and customize your storefront. Support is available the
whole way through.

##### Go live

When you're ready, choose a plan and launch. Most stores go live within 30 days. B2B portals
typically launch in 60–90 days.

[Try for free][98]

## Build and connect your stack.

Open APIs: from out-of-the-box simplicity to fully customized experiences, build what works for you.

600+ integrations: ERP, CRM, PIM, WMS — connect the tools your operations already depend on.

Enterprise-ready: advanced permissions, multi-region support, and the foundation to grow without
hitting platform limits.

Build for tomorrow: when commerce shifts, you shift with it, not against your platform.

[See apps and integrations][99][See enterprise features][100]

★ New — Share of AI

## When shoppers ask AI what to buy, are you in the answer?

Your customers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Amazon Rufus "what's the best [product]?" —
and those answers shape what they buy. Most brands have no idea whether AI recommends them or a
competitor.

Actowiz tracks your **Share of AI** across the assistants your shoppers use — so you can see where
you appear, where you're invisible, and what's driving the recommendation.
* Track brand mentions & ranking inside AI answers
* Benchmark your Share of AI vs. competitors, over time
* See the sources AI cites — and how to influence them

## FAQs about Ecommerce CFOS

Find answers to the most common questions eCommerce founders are wondering about.

[ Read more FAQs ][26]
[ 1. Why CFO Expertise over other CFOs?
][27]

If you're an Ecommerce or D2C brand selling primarily on Shopify and/or Amazon, CFO Expertise was
founded specifically for you. We have 10+ years of experience catering to Ecommerce CFO needs and we
hold that as our primary focus when helping companies. We're entrepreneurs ourselves so we
understand what it's like to scale companies and we apply that first-hand knowledge to helping with
your finances.

[ 2. How much does a fractional CFO cost?
][28]

Most DTC and Ecommerce brands pay between $3k–$10k per month depending on the complexity and scope
of CFO work. The right way to look at it is ROI: a good CFO should save you multiples of their fee
by preventing mistakes, improving cash flow, and unlocking growth. That's what we aim for at CFO
Expertise for all our Ecommerce clients.

[ 3. What finance work is completed each month?
][29]

We deliver accrual-based financials by the 10th of the month, complete with a full KPI dashboard.
The finance dashboard includes COGS, contribution margin, CAC, LTV, payback, shipping costs, and
overhead trends (depending on what package you sign up for). We'll meet with you to review the
financials, provide insights for future growth, and make suggestions based on the data. In addition,
we take on financial projects as they come up for one-time fees on top of your monthly package. 

[ 4. How many meetings do I get?
][30]

This depends on the package that you sign up for. For the majority of our clients, we meet 1-4+
times each month to review financials and work on special projects. For our most basic package,
there aren't any scheduled meetings each month. Instead, you receive a monthly video walkthrough of
your dashboard from your CFO. Additional meetings can always be purchased for a one-time fee.

[ 5. Who is a fractional CFO best for?
][31]

At CFO Expertise, we cater primarily to high-growth Ecommerce and DTC brands doing $1M–$50M+ in
revenue that sell on Shopify and/or Amazon and need financial clarity and cash flow discipline.
We're most ideal for founders who are great at sales and brand-building, but want a strategic
partner to connect finance, marketing, and ops.

[ 6. Can you help me prepare for an exit?
][32]

Yes, of course! A high percentage of our Ecommerce clients are scaling toward acquisition or private
equity. We help you clean up financials, structure your data room, maximize EBITDA, and model
valuations. The goal is simple: make you look bulletproof to buyers.

## FAQs about Ecommerce CFOS

Find answers to the most common questions eCommerce founders are wondering about.

[ Read more FAQs ][26]
[ 1. Why CFO Expertise over other CFOs?
][27]

If you're an Ecommerce or D2C brand selling primarily on Shopify and/or Amazon, CFO Expertise was
founded specifically for you. We have 10+ years of experience catering to Ecommerce CFO needs and we
hold that as our primary focus when helping companies. We're entrepreneurs ourselves so we
understand what it's like to scale companies and we apply that first-hand knowledge to helping with
your finances.

[ 2. How much does a fractional CFO cost?
][28]

Most DTC and Ecommerce brands pay between $3k–$10k per month depending on the complexity and scope
of CFO work. The right way to look at it is ROI: a good CFO should save you multiples of their fee
by preventing mistakes, improving cash flow, and unlocking growth. That's what we aim for at CFO
Expertise for all our Ecommerce clients.

[ 3. What finance work is completed each month?
][29]

We deliver accrual-based financials by the 10th of the month, complete with a full KPI dashboard.
The finance dashboard includes COGS, contribution margin, CAC, LTV, payback, shipping costs, and
overhead trends (depending on what package you sign up for). We'll meet with you to review the
financials, provide insights for future growth, and make suggestions based on the data. In addition,
we take on financial projects as they come up for one-time fees on top of your monthly package. 

[ 4. How many meetings do I get?
][30]

This depends on the package that you sign up for. For the majority of our clients, we meet 1-4+
times each month to review financials and work on special projects. For our most basic package,
there aren't any scheduled meetings each month. Instead, you receive a monthly video walkthrough of
your dashboard from your CFO. Additional meetings can always be purchased for a one-time fee.

[ 5. Who is a fractional CFO best for?
][31]

At CFO Expertise, we cater primarily to high-growth Ecommerce and DTC brands doing $1M–$50M+ in
revenue that sell on Shopify and/or Amazon and need financial clarity and cash flow discipline.
We're most ideal for founders who are great at sales and brand-building, but want a strategic
partner to connect finance, marketing, and ops.

[ 6. Can you help me prepare for an exit?
][32]

Yes, of course! A high percentage of our Ecommerce clients are scaling toward acquisition or private
equity. We help you clean up financials, structure your data room, maximize EBITDA, and model
valuations. The goal is simple: make you look bulletproof to buyers.

# Data Education Designed to Drive Impact

Practical education to turn data into your organization’s greatest asset.

From curated curriculums to industry certifications, we’ll help you **conquer** data chaos and
**future-proof** your governance practices.

## Trusted by Learners & Partners at

[People working at table][People working at table]

## The Global Leader in Data Management Education.

Capitalize on the **single best source of education** for anyone harnessing the power of data —
business leaders, data management practitioners and IT professionals worldwide.

**Our mission is to make data education accessible, practical, and impactful** — helping you solve
today’s toughest challenges, advance your career, and drive meaningful change in your organization.
* Finding data governance training material isn’t always easy. At the DATAVERSITY Training Center,
  there is a vast selection of content in a variety of disciplines.
  
  Donald J. LeMay, CIMP, CDS
  Data Governance Analyst, Amica
* Exceeded expectations. The caliber of presentations, relationships developed, and knowledge gained
  are all priceless. This is the place to come to meet like-minded colleagues and learn from
  industry thought leaders and practitioners.
  
  Stephanie M Davis
  Data Governance Analyst, PTC
* All of the courses and sections were broken into parts that could be readily digested for
  efficient learning. This helped me compartmentalize my entire training program.
  
  A recent DATAVERSITY Training Center student
  United States Military
* DATAVERSITY’s training is created by industry thought leaders and consummate professionals with
  years of experience. There is no more impactful collection of training videos on data governance
  or data management on the web.
  
  Guy Gore
  Data Governance Analyst, Fortune 500 financial services company


## Find Your People, Fuel Your Passion.

Without access to breakthrough knowledge and networking, growth can feel out of reach. We believe
collaboration doesn’t just lighten the load — it multiplies your impact. Join a community you can
count on.

DATAVERSITY in-person conferences and online events directly connect you with industry leaders,
peers, and cutting-edge solutions to tackle your toughest data challenges head-on.

[Explore Upcoming Events][38]

[ [Conference logo][Conference logo] ][39]

## DGIQ + AIGov 2026

November 16-19, 2026 | Providence, Rhode Island

[ Register Now ][40] [ Learn More ][41]

## The Gold Standard in Data Management Certification & Training.

Build unshakable credibility with DATAVERSITY’s certification programs.

### Applied Data Governance Certification

Establish your credibility as a data governance leader.

Earn industry-recognized certification that demonstrates your expertise in building effective
governance programs. Designed to provide real-world application of governance practices, you’ll
learn to implement frameworks, engage stakeholders, and solve complex governance challenges
effectively.

[ Get Certified ][42]

### CDMP Certification Training

Study smarter — not harder.

DATAVERSITY offers the leading DAMA-International-endorsed CDMP Certification Training for data
professionals.

Our expert-led training makes it simple to understand and master the DMBOK concepts. With clear
objectives, expert guidance, and comprehensive resources, we help you target what matters most.

[ Start Studying ][43]
[woman-speaking-at-conference-min][woman-speaking-at-conference-min]

## Empowering Women in Data Management & Governance.

Women in Data Management & Governance is a community dedicated to amplifying women and marginalized
genders, championing authentic leadership, and fostering a culture where empowerment and growth take
center stage.

Explore resources, workshops, and networking opportunities designed to help women overcome barriers
and achieve leadership roles in the field.

The future of data is inclusive — Women in Data Management & Governance at DATAVERSITY is leading
the charge.

[Join Our Community][44]

## Learn Anywhere, Anytime.

## Easy Commerce — IT-решения для аналитики, управления
## и роста продаж в онлайн-торговле

[Получить консультацию][9]

##### Инструмент аналитики

## Commerce Analytics Tool

Панель визуализации (Дэшборд) со сторонней поддержкой, который анализирует данные
и помогает принимать эффективные решения для онлайн торговли (e-com).
[slide]
Оценка видимости бренда (SoV)
[На страницу Commerce Analytics Tool][10]

## Услуги e-com (онлайн торговля)

На базе собственной экспертизы в аналитике
и возможностей Commerce Analytics Tool можем оказать следующие услуги:

[Оставить заявку на услугу][11]
* [svg]
  
  ### Аналитика категорий на площадках
  
  Делаем глубокую аналитику по каждой площадке и бренду внутри категорий. Проводим анализ
  распределения товаров по вкладу в прибыль (ABC анализ) категорий и находим потенциальные точки
  роста.
* [svg]
  
  ### Медийная поддержка
  
  Подбираем наиболее эффективные форматы внутри площадок с прогнозом по  рентабельности расходов на
  рекламу (ROAS). Реализуем аудиторный подход для ведения внешнего трафика на продуктовую карточку.
* [svg]
  
  ### Подготовка контента для продуктовых карточек
  
  Делаем 360 фото и видео товаров. Адаптируем фото-контент под площадки. Разрабатываем наиболее
  эффективное описание продуктовых карточек внутри площадок. Создаем расширенное мультимедийное
  описание товара (rich-контент).
* [svg]
  
  ### Выведение карточек товара в ТОП выдачи
  
  Определяем основные факторы, которые влияют на выдачу на конкретной площадке. Управляем ставками
  по товарам на площадках. Проводим оптимизацию для поисковых движков (SEO) продуктовых карточек
  и используем возможности площадок для повышения позиций.
* [svg]
  
  ### Динамическое ценообразование
  
  Разрабатываем промо-календарь. Настраиваем автоматическое управление ценой на базе 50+ параметров.
  Удерживаем целевую маржинальность при максимизации продаж.
* [svg]
  
  ### Работа с репутацией
  
  Разбираем все отзывы в категории и анализируем атрибуты, на которые нужно обратить внимание.
  Нативно генерируем отзывы на площадках. Отвечаем от лица бренда.
* [svg]
  
  ### Комплексная стратегия и консалтинг
  
  Анализируем тренды рынка, целевую аудиторию и действия конкурентов. Выявляем точки роста бренда на
  площадках онлайн торговли. Анализируем и устраняем барьеры в пути клиента (CJM). Формируем
  основанную на данных стратегию поддержки и развития бренда для достижения бизнес- и маркетинговых
  целей.
* [svg]
  
  ### Аудит магазина
  
  Проводим исследование внутри кабинетов продавцов. Сравниваем ваш магазин и карточки с показателями
  в категории и лидерами по обороту продаж. Анализируем цены, остатки, индекс локализации, контент,
  рейтинг, рекламу и видимость. Показываем отклонения и даём точечные рекомендации по оптимизации
  работы с кабинетом продавца.

  распределения товаров по вкладу в прибыль (ABC анализ) категорий и находим потенциальные точки
  роста.
* [svg]
  
  ### Медийная поддержка
  
  Подбираем наиболее эффективные форматы внутри площадок с прогнозом по  рентабельности расходов на
  рекламу (ROAS). Реализуем аудиторный подход для ведения внешнего трафика на продуктовую карточку.
* [svg]
  
  ### Подготовка контента для продуктовых карточек
  
  Делаем 360 фото и видео товаров. Адаптируем фото-контент под площадки. Разрабатываем наиболее
  эффективное описание продуктовых карточек внутри площадок. Создаем расширенное мультимедийное
  описание товара (rich-контент).
* [svg]
  
  ### Выведение карточек товара в ТОП выдачи
  
  Определяем основные факторы, которые влияют на выдачу на конкретной площадке. Управляем ставками
  по товарам на площадках. Проводим оптимизацию для поисковых движков (SEO) продуктовых карточек
  и используем возможности площадок для повышения позиций.
* [svg]
  
  ### Динамическое ценообразование
  
  Разрабатываем промо-календарь. Настраиваем автоматическое управление ценой на базе 50+ параметров.
  Удерживаем целевую маржинальность при максимизации продаж.
* [svg]
  
  ### Работа с репутацией
  
  Разбираем все отзывы в категории и анализируем атрибуты, на которые нужно обратить внимание.
  Нативно генерируем отзывы на площадках. Отвечаем от лица бренда.
* [svg]
  
  ### Комплексная стратегия и консалтинг
  
  Анализируем тренды рынка, целевую аудиторию и действия конкурентов. Выявляем точки роста бренда на
  площадках онлайн торговли. Анализируем и устраняем барьеры в пути клиента (CJM). Формируем
  основанную на данных стратегию поддержки и развития бренда для достижения бизнес- и маркетинговых
  целей.
* [svg]
  
  ### Аудит магазина
  
  Проводим исследование внутри кабинетов продавцов. Сравниваем ваш магазин и карточки с показателями
  в категории и лидерами по обороту продаж. Анализируем цены, остатки, индекс локализации, контент,
  рейтинг, рекламу и видимость. Показываем отклонения и даём точечные рекомендации по оптимизации
  работы с кабинетом продавца.

Use Cases

### Built for Your Industry

E-commerce looks different depending on where you sit. ECDB is built for the questions that matter
most in your role and your market.

Select Your Industry

Brands & ManufacturersRetailersAgencies & ConsultanciesFinanceLogistics

Use Cases

#### Retail Channel Intelligence

Retailer SelectionDistribution PlanningChannel BenchmarkingPartner PrioritizationCategory Leadership

#### Category Sizing & Trends

Market SizingCategory Growth AnalysisLaunch ReadinessTrend ForecastingDemand Planning

#### Negotiation Readiness

Retailer Negotiation PrepAccount PlanningPerformance JustificationKPI BenchmarkingData-Backed
Pitching
Benefits

### What Makes ECDB Intelligence Different

Most market data is built on proxies. ECDB is built on what actually happened, modeled by the people
who know the data inside out.

#### Transaction-Based

We start where others don't. Real purchase data from card issuers and payment processors. The
closest signal to what actually happened in the market.

#### Analyst-Modeled

Our analysts are in the driving seat. They apply proprietary models and AI to turn raw inputs into
structured, cross-validated intelligence you can act on.

#### Revenue, Not Traffic

Traffic is a proxy. Revenue is reality. ECDB measures what people actually spend, making every
benchmark and every comparison a harder, more defensible number.

### Start Exploring E-Commerce Intelligence

See how ECDB helps you benchmark markets, analyze competitors, and turn data into decisions.

Benefits

### What Makes ECDB Intelligence Different

Most market data is built on proxies. ECDB is built on what actually happened, modeled by the people
who know the data inside out.

#### Transaction-Based

We start where others don't. Real purchase data from card issuers and payment processors. The
closest signal to what actually happened in the market.

#### Analyst-Modeled

Our analysts are in the driving seat. They apply proprietary models and AI to turn raw inputs into
structured, cross-validated intelligence you can act on.

#### Revenue, Not Traffic

Traffic is a proxy. Revenue is reality. ECDB measures what people actually spend, making every
benchmark and every comparison a harder, more defensible number.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Funnelytics

##### How is Funnelytics different from Google Analytics?

While Google Analytics shows you what happened, Funnelytics shows you why it happened. We provide
visual journey mapping, cross-platform attribution, and actionable insights that help you optimize
each step of your funnel.

##### How quickly can I see results?

Most customers start seeing insights within 24-48 hours of setup. Meaningful optimizations typically
happen within the first 2-4 weeks, with significant revenue improvements often seen within 30-60
days.

##### Do I need technical skills to use Funnelytics?

Not at all! Our platform is designed for marketers, not developers. The visual interface makes it
easy to understand your customer journeys, and our team can handle the technical setup if you choose
our Done For You service.

##### What platforms does Funnelytics integrate with?

We integrate with all major platforms including Shopify, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads, Google Ads,
and hundreds of others via Zapier and webhooks. If you use it for marketing, we can probably track
it.

##### Is there a free trial?

Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full access to the platform. No credit card required to
start. You can explore all features and see the value before making any commitment.

##### What kind of support do you provide?

All plans include comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, and email support. Done For You
customers get dedicated success managers and bi-weekly optimization calls to ensure maximum results.

Funnelytics helps you uncover the truth about your marketing — and turn insight into performance.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Funnelytics

##### How is Funnelytics different from Google Analytics?

While Google Analytics shows you what happened, Funnelytics shows you why it happened. We provide
visual journey mapping, cross-platform attribution, and actionable insights that help you optimize
each step of your funnel.

##### How quickly can I see results?

Most customers start seeing insights within 24-48 hours of setup. Meaningful optimizations typically
happen within the first 2-4 weeks, with significant revenue improvements often seen within 30-60
days.

##### Do I need technical skills to use Funnelytics?

Not at all! Our platform is designed for marketers, not developers. The visual interface makes it
easy to understand your customer journeys, and our team can handle the technical setup if you choose
our Done For You service.

##### What platforms does Funnelytics integrate with?

We integrate with all major platforms including Shopify, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads, Google Ads,
and hundreds of others via Zapier and webhooks. If you use it for marketing, we can probably track
it.

##### Is there a free trial?

Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full access to the platform. No credit card required to
start. You can explore all features and see the value before making any commitment.

##### What kind of support do you provide?

All plans include comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, and email support. Done For You
customers get dedicated success managers and bi-weekly optimization calls to ensure maximum results.

Fathom.ai is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls on Zoom,
Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company was founded in 2020 by Richard White, a computer
science engineer who previously co-built UserVoice over roughly 12 years, scaling it to $10 million
in revenue before transitioning out in 2019. Fathom has grown from $100K ARR in 2022 to $1M in 2023,
$10M in 2024, and $30M in 2025, a trajectory White describes as "zero to one, one to 10, and 10 to
30 in the first three years of monetization." The company has raised $30 million total across three
rounds, including a $10M seed in 2021, a $3M seed in 2023, and a $17M Series A in 2024 at a $73M
valuation. The team has grown to 100 people. Average revenue per customer is approximately $25 per
seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.
That bet proved correct, and the free individual tier became the distribution engine for a paid team
product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### How does heatmap track revenue on my website?

We have a unique User ID per session on your website. With a snippet in your site header and thank
you page, we’re able to track all your transactions with revenue and all the pre-purchase actions
someone took on your website.

#### Does heatmap work on every website?

Yes! Any CMS (Shopify, Wordpress, WooCommerce, Webflow, Clickfunnels, etc) as well as fully custom
websites. We built custom snippets for each platform to track revenue.

#### Will this slow down my website?

No! We built Website-Speed Protection into our product to be faster than all competitors. Our
snippet is only 8kb. We split-tested over $2 million in revenue with and without Heatmap.com and
there was no change in performance!

#### How long does it take to install?

Two minutes or less. Our onboarding walks you through step-by-step (with videos) to show you how to
install the snippets.

#### Do I need developers to install heatmap?

Probably not! You only need to install snippets which you can copy & paste from Heatmap.com’s
Onboarding docs.

#### Can I install heatmap on Google Tag Manager?

Yes you can! You’ll need to make sure your goal settings are lined-up with the default Heatmap.com
tracking metrics. If not, our developers will handle this for you!

#### Is heatmap GDPR Compliant?

Yes. 100% GDPR compliant.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### How does heatmap track revenue on my website?

We have a unique User ID per session on your website. With a snippet in your site header and thank
you page, we’re able to track all your transactions with revenue and all the pre-purchase actions
someone took on your website.

#### Does heatmap work on every website?

Yes! Any CMS (Shopify, Wordpress, WooCommerce, Webflow, Clickfunnels, etc) as well as fully custom
websites. We built custom snippets for each platform to track revenue.

#### Will this slow down my website?

No! We built Website-Speed Protection into our product to be faster than all competitors. Our
snippet is only 8kb. We split-tested over $2 million in revenue with and without Heatmap.com and
there was no change in performance!

#### How long does it take to install?

Two minutes or less. Our onboarding walks you through step-by-step (with videos) to show you how to
install the snippets.

#### Do I need developers to install heatmap?

Probably not! You only need to install snippets which you can copy & paste from Heatmap.com’s
Onboarding docs.

#### Can I install heatmap on Google Tag Manager?

Yes you can! You’ll need to make sure your goal settings are lined-up with the default Heatmap.com
tracking metrics. If not, our developers will handle this for you!

#### Is heatmap GDPR Compliant?

Yes. 100% GDPR compliant.

## FAQs

### What is Kalodata and why should I use it?

Kalodata is a data analytics and insights tool for TikTok shop. By providing information on trending
products, talented influencers, trending short videos, quality livestreams, market research,
competitive analyses, we can help TikTok shop sellers/brands/creators/affiliates make better and
data-driven decisions to increase their sales and revenues, as well as boost the efficiency of
day-to-day operations.

### How does Kalodata get its data, and how accurate is it?

Kalodata gathers TikTok e-commerce data by having our tech team collect information from public
channels. We then use advanced AI models and data processing techniques to refine this data. Keep in
mind that certain details, like transaction amounts and ad spending, might have small variations
from real-world numbers. With our models getting trained and updated daily, the accuracy of our data
is continually improving. Our main goal is to help users discover products, stores, and content that
are worth exploring, learning from, and getting inspired by, enabling them to shape well-informed
business strategies. However, it's important not to use our data in situations requiring high
precision, such as partner commission settlements or performance evaluations.

### What is the background of the team?

Our management team came from TikTok's global e-commerce division and were the key members in the
development of TikTok Shop from the beginning. Additionally, our core team consists of professionals
with extensive experience in data analysis, social media, and marketing. The team members have
served renowned enterprises and institutions and possess successful project experience and industry
insights.

### What is the pricing of Kalodata?

Please go to[https://www.kalodata.com/pricing][16].

### Is Kalodata affiliated with TikTok Shop?

No. Kalodata is an independent SaaS analytics platform operated by Kalowave Technology Co., Limited.
Kalodata is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially associated with TikTok,
TikTok Shop, or ByteDance. TikTok and TikTok Shop are trademarks of their respective owners and are
referenced only to describe the e-commerce ecosystem, marketplace, and data categories analyzed by
Kalodata.

### Does Kalodata have an affiliate program?

Yes! We welcome content creators and community leaders to join our affiliate program. Please[contact
us][17]for more details.

Disclaimer: Kalodata is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially associated
with TikTok, TikTok Shop, or ByteDance.

Kalodata gathers TikTok e-commerce data by having our tech team collect information from public
channels. We then use advanced AI models and data processing techniques to refine this data. Keep in
mind that certain details, like transaction amounts and ad spending, might have small variations
from real-world numbers. With our models getting trained and updated daily, the accuracy of our data

precision, such as partner commission settlements or performance evaluations.

Like access, read, transform, merge, split, learn, predict, write, visualize.

Workflows depict sequential steps performed on data from left to right.

### You decide when to run your workflow.

Run the workflow node by node, in segments, or all at once. Re-run any time.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like clean and filter.

### Workflows let you do (almost) anything with data—like perform a simple analysis.

subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

## Learn How Our Customers are Succeeding with MapBusinessOnline

[Chris Farcher]

"*MapBusinessOnline is an amazing tool that I use every week. When you are creating zip code
footprints and trying to determine what zip codes fall within a range of a business, this tool
couldn't be any easier to use. There's actually so many functions that are great but specifically I
use MapBusinessOnline to create either a mile radius or a drive time radius from a business
location. I then use that radius to determine which zip codes fall within the radius. Why is this
important? Because I then export the zip codes and use another software that gets me exact counts of
how many people fall within that radius in those zip codes. It's Amazing!*

*I highly recommend this software!*"

Chris Farcher
Account Manager
The Mailworks

[Colette Bell]

"*I have had the pleasure of using MapBusinessOnline for the past 5 years and it is an excellent and
affordable tool for my clients. I am a franchise consultant, and many of my clients are just
starting to get into franchising. The first main question many of them have is they don’t know the
demographics around their current location, so they don’t know how to create territories for their
franchisees. I am able to easily utilize MapBusinessOnline to draw a prototype territory around
their existing location, do a deep dive into the many different demographics that MapBusinessOnline
offers, and help the client determine the basics of their new territories, including mileage,
population, household count, purchasing habits and age distributions. This tool has been so helpful
that many of our clients obtain their own accounts as they begin to sell franchises and grow their
business. Thank you, MapBusinessOnline, for providing such a helpful tool that is affordable and
easy to use!*"

Colette Bell
Director of Business Development
SMB Franchise Advisors

[Bill Hanavan]

"*I have been using MapBusinessOnline for about 8 months and couldn’t be happier with the services
it provides. I have employees and myself who map around 250 routes monthly for our sales team. The
interface is easy-to-use and the abilities are exactly what I need. My sales team finds the maps and
step by step routes easy to follow and accurate. My store lists change every quarter and the
uploading system allows me to quickly upload a new list and categorize the account by priority using
colors and shapes. I have also used the heat mapping capabilities and found those easy to customize
and quick to use. As with any advanced software, this does take a week or two to learn the more
complex features, but it is well worth the time invested. This is the software I would have designed
if I was to create one myself. Great job!!!*"

Bill Hanavan
Director of Operations
Strategic Retail Solutions

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

### .research

Currently, I am using meta-analysis to look for “original discoveries and contributions by mining
the untapped veins of information in accumulated research literatures.” ([Hunter & Schmidt 2004,
p. 21][6])

In general, I believe that research is inherently cross-disciplinary:
* Data science helps us to distill interesting patterns from human behavior.
* Qualitative research helps us to understand the meaning of these patterns.
* Experimental research and design research help us to use this understanding to build more
  effective information systems.

### .methods
* Meta-analysis
* Experiments
* Data Science
* Qualitative Document Analysis
* Philosophy of Science

### .projects
* Your Time for Science - A mobile platform for economic experiments
* The relationship of project control and project performance
* User participation, risk, and project performance
* Repeated interactions in IT outsourcing

### .log
* Köhn, T., Gottlieb, M., Schermann, M., Krcmar, H.: Improving take-over quality in automated
  driving by interrupting non-driving tasks at the 24th International Conference on Intelligent User

  Sufficient” at ECIS 2018

# Data Mining Fruitful and Fun

Open source machine learning and data visualization.

[Download Orange 3.40.0][8]

May 08, 2026

## [Gairdin: Traditional Slovenian Houses - Reinvented][9]

Students can now explore Slovenian houses in a completely unplugged way.

[[Gairdin: Traditional Slovenian Houses - Reinvented]][10]

Apr 14, 2026

### [Gairdin: Gnomes with the Youngest Students][11]

We explored what the gnomes are doing together with the youngest primary school students and had a
lot of fun along the way.

[[Gairdin: Gnomes with the Youngest Students]][12]

Dec 31, 2025

### [Orange Essentials: Interactive Workflows][13]

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to turn Orange into an interactive data exploration tool.

[[Orange Essentials: Interactive Workflows]][14]

Dec 24, 2025

### [Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows][15]

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to annotate workflows in Orange.

[[Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows]][16]

## Visual Programming

No coding needed. Place widgets on the canvas, connect them, load your datasets, and harvest the
insight!

[ Learn more][17][Watch video][18]

## Interactive Data Visualization

Explore statistical distributions, box plots and scatter plots, or dive deeper with decision trees,
hierarchical clustering, heatmaps, MDS, t-SNE and linear projections. Even your multidimensional
data can make sense.

[ Learn more][19]

## Extensions

Specialized add-ons can perform natural language processing and text mining, conduct network
analysis, do association rules mining, or address fairness in machine learning. Some address
specialized data, such as time series, survival data sets, spectra, or gene expressions. Also, check
out Orange's cousin [Quasar][20].

[Watch video][21]

## Teach with Orange

When teaching data mining, we like to illustrate rather than only explain. And Orange is great at
that. Used at schools, universities and in professional training courses across the world, Orange
supports hands-on training and visual illustrations of concepts from data science. There are even
widgets that were especially designed for teaching.

[Learn more][22]

My laboratory produces large amounts of data from RNA-seq, ChIP-seq and genome resequencing
experiments.  Orange allows me to analyze my data even though I don’t know how to program.  It also
allows me to communicate with my collaborators, who are experts in data mining, and with my
colleagues and trainees.

**Gad Shaulsky, Ph.D.**

Molecular biologist and Director of Graduate Studies (Baylor College of Medicine, Houston, USA)

The scientific community is in need of tools that allow easy construction of workflows and
visualizations and are capable of analyzing large amounts of data. Orange is a powerful platform to
perform data analysis and visualization, see data flow and become more productive. It provides a
clean, open source platform and the possibility to add further functionality for all fields of
science.

**Ferenc Borondics, Ph.D.**

Principal beamline scientist at SMIS (SOLEIL synchrotron, France)

I teach Orange workshops monthly to a diverse audience, from undergrad students to expert
researchers. Orange is very intuitive, and, by the end of the workshop, the participants are able to
perform complex data visualization and basic machine learning analyses. Most of our attendees have
been able to incorporate this tool in their research practice.

**Francesca Vitali, Ph.D.**

Research Assistant Professor (Center for Biomedical Informatics & Biostatistics, The University of
Arizona)

## Contribute to Orange

If you love using Orange and want to support us, a donation would be very much appreciated. The
funds help us fix bugs, implement new features, provide free educational content, and maintain
computational infrastructure.

# Data Mining Fruitful and Fun

Open source machine learning and data visualization.

[Download Orange 3.40.0][8]

May 08, 2026

## [Gairdin: Traditional Slovenian Houses - Reinvented][9]

Students can now explore Slovenian houses in a completely unplugged way.

[[Gairdin: Traditional Slovenian Houses - Reinvented]][10]

Apr 14, 2026

### [Gairdin: Gnomes with the Youngest Students][11]

We explored what the gnomes are doing together with the youngest primary school students and had a
lot of fun along the way.

[[Gairdin: Gnomes with the Youngest Students]][12]

Dec 31, 2025

### [Orange Essentials: Interactive Workflows][13]

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to turn Orange into an interactive data exploration tool.

[[Orange Essentials: Interactive Workflows]][14]

Dec 24, 2025

### [Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows][15]

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to annotate workflows in Orange.

[[Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows]][16]

## Visual Programming

No coding needed. Place widgets on the canvas, connect them, load your datasets, and harvest the
insight!

[ Learn more][17][Watch video][18]

## Interactive Data Visualization

Explore statistical distributions, box plots and scatter plots, or dive deeper with decision trees,
hierarchical clustering, heatmaps, MDS, t-SNE and linear projections. Even your multidimensional
data can make sense.

[ Learn more][19]

## Extensions

Specialized add-ons can perform natural language processing and text mining, conduct network
analysis, do association rules mining, or address fairness in machine learning. Some address
specialized data, such as time series, survival data sets, spectra, or gene expressions. Also, check
out Orange's cousin [Quasar][20].

[Watch video][21]

## Teach with Orange

When teaching data mining, we like to illustrate rather than only explain. And Orange is great at
that. Used at schools, universities and in professional training courses across the world, Orange
supports hands-on training and visual illustrations of concepts from data science. There are even
widgets that were especially designed for teaching.

[Learn more][22]

My laboratory produces large amounts of data from RNA-seq, ChIP-seq and genome resequencing
experiments.  Orange allows me to analyze my data even though I don’t know how to program.  It also
allows me to communicate with my collaborators, who are experts in data mining, and with my
colleagues and trainees.

**Gad Shaulsky, Ph.D.**

Molecular biologist and Director of Graduate Studies (Baylor College of Medicine, Houston, USA)

The scientific community is in need of tools that allow easy construction of workflows and
visualizations and are capable of analyzing large amounts of data. Orange is a powerful platform to
perform data analysis and visualization, see data flow and become more productive. It provides a
clean, open source platform and the possibility to add further functionality for all fields of
science.

**Ferenc Borondics, Ph.D.**

Principal beamline scientist at SMIS (SOLEIL synchrotron, France)

I teach Orange workshops monthly to a diverse audience, from undergrad students to expert
researchers. Orange is very intuitive, and, by the end of the workshop, the participants are able to
perform complex data visualization and basic machine learning analyses. Most of our attendees have
been able to incorporate this tool in their research practice.

**Francesca Vitali, Ph.D.**

Research Assistant Professor (Center for Biomedical Informatics & Biostatistics, The University of
Arizona)

## Contribute to Orange

If you love using Orange and want to support us, a donation would be very much appreciated. The
funds help us fix bugs, implement new features, provide free educational content, and maintain
computational infrastructure.

How do you manage AI project implementation?

We use agile project management with weekly sprints, clear milestones, and transparent reporting.
Every project has a dedicated lead, a shared roadmap, and bi-weekly demos so you always know where
things stand.

What AI technologies do you specialize in?

We specialize in machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and large language
models including GPT, Claude, and custom fine-tuned models. We also work with agentic AI frameworks
for autonomous workflow orchestration.

How do you ensure AI project success?

Success is measured through clear KPIs: cost reduction (30%+), revenue increase, efficiency gains,
and user satisfaction. We set these metrics upfront and report against them continuously.

What is your typical project timeline?

Most AI readiness engagements run for 4 weeks: week 1 for assessment, week 2 for integration, week 3
for training, and week 4 for optimisation and handover. Custom software and platform builds are
scoped per project.

How do you handle AI project risks?

We mitigate risks through thorough testing, data validation, and gradual rollout. This includes A/B
testing, compliance checks, security audits, and rollback plans for every deployment.

What makes PADISO different from other agencies?

We combine deep technical expertise with proven methodologies. Our team focuses on rapid deployment,
measurable ROI, and hands-on implementation rather than just advisory. We build alongside you, not
from the sidelines.

Success is measured through clear KPIs: cost reduction (30%+), revenue increase, efficiency gains,
and user satisfaction. We set these metrics upfront and report against them continuously.

What is your typical project timeline?

Most AI readiness engagements run for 4 weeks: week 1 for assessment, week 2 for integration, week 3
for training, and week 4 for optimisation and handover. Custom software and platform builds are
scoped per project.

How do you handle AI project risks?

We mitigate risks through thorough testing, data validation, and gradual rollout. This includes A/B
testing, compliance checks, security audits, and rollback plans for every deployment.

What makes PADISO different from other agencies?

We combine deep technical expertise with proven methodologies. Our team focuses on rapid deployment,
measurable ROI, and hands-on implementation rather than just advisory. We build alongside you, not
from the sidelines.

[iGB Affiliate Barcelona 2026]
iGB Affiliate Barcelona 2026

**Spain, Barcelona** – 20-21 January

At iGB Affiliate Barcelona, we spent most of our time with marketing networks, media buyers, and
affiliates, who all run into the same problem: paying partners across borders without delays. We
showed how our system handles mass payouts, sending funds to hundreds of partners at once instead of
processing them one by one.

 

[G Gate Conf 2026]
G Gate Conf 2026

**Georgia, Tbilisi** – 26-27 June

We closed out the first half of the year at G Gate Conf in Tbilisi, meeting regional tech companies
and e-commerce platforms. Several were still running on bank transfers and manual invoicing, so we
walked them through what it takes to add crypto payments without rebuilding their existing setup.

[ICE Barcelona 2026]
ICE Barcelona 2026

**Spain, Barcelona** – 19-21 January

ICE is one of the largest B2B tech exhibitions in the industry, and we used it to introduce our
multi-chain payment infrastructure to enterprise platforms and software providers. Most questions
were about network fees: how our flat-fee model on TRC20 and batch transaction processing cut down
costs, and what that means for a platform's margins.

[MAC Affiliate Conference 2026]
MAC Affiliate Conference 2026

**Armenia, Yerevan** – 26-27 May

Many of the conversations at MAC came back to volatility: merchants get paid in crypto but don't
want to depend on the exchange rate. Our instant conversion tools lock in the price at the moment of
payment, so the business is no longer exposed to rate swings. 

[iFX EXPO Dubai 2026]
iFX EXPO Dubai 2026

**UAE, Dubai** – 10-12 February

At iFX EXPO Dubai, we talked with institutional brokers, liquidity providers, and fintech brands
about our payment infrastructure. Most of the interest was around integration: how a platform can
add crypto payment flows directly to its own website without redirecting users elsewhere.

[SiGMA Rome 2025]
SiGMA Rome 2025

**Italy, Rome** – 4-6 November

At SiGMA Rome, we met with European fintech companies, digital merchants, and regulators. Most
conversations at our booth came back to processing: invoicing that's easy to set up, withdrawals
that run automatically, and an analytics dashboard that shows exactly where fees go.

quickly they could open a business account and start accepting crypto payments.

## Let’s connect

Ready to transform your work with data storytelling? Connect with our team to learn more and get
started today!

[Get in touch][41]
What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

#### Still curious?

## Get quick answers before you start

Explore common questions about Putler’s setup, integrations, pricing, and capabilities. Can’t find
your question? [Contact our team][17].

* How does Putler solve eCommerce analytics challenges? *
  Putler automatically consolidates fragmented data from payment gateways (PayPal / Stripe),
  platforms (Shopify / eBay / WooCommerce), and Google Analytics into one powerful dashboard.
  
  It fixes data discrepancies, identifies customer lifetime value, tracks product performance,
  detects churn risks, and provides accurate revenue forecasting, giving you complete clarity and
  control over your business.
  
  Different plans allow for different number of data sources.
* Which eCommerce platforms work with Putler? *
  Putler works seamlessly with major platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, eBay, Etsy, BigCommerce,
  and Easy Digital Downloads.
  
  It also integrates with PayPal, Stripe, Braintree, Google Analytics, and Mailchimp.
  
  See the full list [here][18].
* What makes Putler different from Google Analytics? *
  While Google Analytics tracks website behavior, Putler specializes in eCommerce intelligence,
  especially post-purchase.
  
  Putler gives you:
  → Unified revenue tracking across platforms
  → Customer-centric metrics like LTV, ARPU
  → Clean, corrected data from payment gateways and eCommerce platforms
  → Subscription analytics
  → Accurate financial forecasting
  
  All of this in one clean, intuitive dashboard.
* Can I try Putler before committing? *
  Yes! Start with our 14-day free trial and get full access to all features, no credit card
  required. Connect your data sources, explore advanced analytics, and experience value from day one
  before any long-term commitment.
* How does Putler’s revenue-based pricing work? *
  Putler offers a flexible pricing model based on your business needs.
  
  If you want to upgrade to a paid plan, you need to pay a one time, sign up fee of $1. You can then
  use Putler for 30 days. After 30 days, Putler will review the revenue of the last 30 days and
  allot you either to the Starter or the Growth plan. You can look at the various pricing slabs
  [here][19].
  
  → Starter: $20/month – for small businesses (includes 3 data sources, 2 years of data)
  → Growth: starts at $50/month – for scaling teams (15 data sources, 5 years of data, unlimited
  users)
  → Custom: Tailored plans for large businesses or agencies
* Does Putler require technical setup? *
  No. There’s zero coding involved.
  
  Just connect your platforms via secure OAuth – setup takes under 5 minutes.
  
  Putler will:
  → Sync up your historical data
  → Standardize multi-currency transactions
  → Merge duplicate customer records
  → Correct payment gateway discrepancies
  
  You’ll see actionable insights within 15 minutes of connection.

Open [Putler app][20] to access

## Get quick answers before you start

Explore common questions about Putler’s setup, integrations, pricing, and capabilities. Can’t find
your question? [Contact our team][17].

* How does Putler solve eCommerce analytics challenges? *
  Putler automatically consolidates fragmented data from payment gateways (PayPal / Stripe),
  platforms (Shopify / eBay / WooCommerce), and Google Analytics into one powerful dashboard.
  
  It fixes data discrepancies, identifies customer lifetime value, tracks product performance,
  detects churn risks, and provides accurate revenue forecasting, giving you complete clarity and
  control over your business.
  
  Different plans allow for different number of data sources.
* Which eCommerce platforms work with Putler? *
  Putler works seamlessly with major platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, eBay, Etsy, BigCommerce,
  and Easy Digital Downloads.
  
  It also integrates with PayPal, Stripe, Braintree, Google Analytics, and Mailchimp.
  
  See the full list [here][18].
* What makes Putler different from Google Analytics? *
  While Google Analytics tracks website behavior, Putler specializes in eCommerce intelligence,
  especially post-purchase.
  
  Putler gives you:
  → Unified revenue tracking across platforms
  → Customer-centric metrics like LTV, ARPU
  → Clean, corrected data from payment gateways and eCommerce platforms
  → Subscription analytics
  → Accurate financial forecasting
  
  All of this in one clean, intuitive dashboard.
* Can I try Putler before committing? *
  Yes! Start with our 14-day free trial and get full access to all features, no credit card
  required. Connect your data sources, explore advanced analytics, and experience value from day one
  before any long-term commitment.
* How does Putler’s revenue-based pricing work? *
  Putler offers a flexible pricing model based on your business needs.
  
  If you want to upgrade to a paid plan, you need to pay a one time, sign up fee of $1. You can then
  use Putler for 30 days. After 30 days, Putler will review the revenue of the last 30 days and
  allot you either to the Starter or the Growth plan. You can look at the various pricing slabs
  [here][19].
  
  → Starter: $20/month – for small businesses (includes 3 data sources, 2 years of data)
  → Growth: starts at $50/month – for scaling teams (15 data sources, 5 years of data, unlimited
  users)
  → Custom: Tailored plans for large businesses or agencies
* Does Putler require technical setup? *
  No. There’s zero coding involved.
  
  Just connect your platforms via secure OAuth – setup takes under 5 minutes.
  
  Putler will:
  → Sync up your historical data
  → Standardize multi-currency transactions
  → Merge duplicate customer records
  → Correct payment gateway discrepancies
  
  You’ll see actionable insights within 15 minutes of connection.

## What ERPs does Sana Commerce integrate with?

Sana Commerce integrates with SAP and Microsoft Dynamics. That includes SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA,
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. The
integration is direct, meaning Sana reads pricing, inventory, customer and order data from the ERP
itself rather than through middleware or a separate database.

## What makes Sana Commerce different from other B2B e-commerce platforms?

Most B2B platforms keep their own copy of your data and sync to the ERP overnight. Sana Commerce
doesn't. It reads pricing, stock and customer terms directly from SAP or Micro

## Why Meesho sellers lose money without knowing.

Meesho's Supplier Panel hides your real cost overheads. Between commissions, ad burns, RTO fees,
penalties, and taxes — your true profit is a black box.

### Hidden Deductions

Commission fees, penalties, and packaging charges are deducted automatically. Meesho takes 15% to
40% off your top-line sales silently.

### RTO Return Penalties

Every customer return and RTO costs you two-way logistics and packaging fees. Without SKU tracking,
returns eat your entire margin.

### Unreconciled Payments

Did Meesho actually payout for every single order marked 'Delivered'? Up to 2% of settlements are
missed or incorrectly adjusted.

### Ad Spend Black Hole

Running supplier ads without knowing your product-level ROAS? You might be spending thousands
pushing SKUs that run at a net loss.

### Blind COGS Calculations

Spreadsheets can't keep up with changing product costs. If you don't calculate your weighted average
COGS, your P&L numbers are incorrect.

### Scattered GST Ledgers

ITR and GST filing requires matching TCS and TDS withholdings across hundreds of files. It's a
massive, expensive compliance headache.

Command Suite

## In one unified workspace.

Say goodbye to messy spreadsheets. Upload your supplier reports and see your business metrics in
real-time.

### Real-Time P&L Workspace

Sales, deductions, returns, and net margins automatically parsed and calculated from your report
uploads. Track day-by-day performance instantly.

Assign product manufacturing costs (COGS), packaging fees, and ad budgets per SKU to calculate true
net margins.

### Return & RTO Analytics

Spot high-RTO items draining store profits. Clean metrics to decide which products to drop.

### Multi-Store Management

Isolate data workspaces per store or GST number. Switch profiles seamlessly.

Sync orders, payout sheets, and returns in one click directly from the Meesho supplier panel. No

# Your growth is capped by your

More often than not, businesses looking for growth don’t need to do more — they need what they
already have to work as one system. Right now marketing, sales, delivery and data don’t talk to each
other, and revenue leaks in the gaps.

We connect them and add or optimise the process, technology and AI around them — every stage owned,
every metric counted. Then we prove the value before you commit a pound: most engagements surface at
least **20% measurable value within 90 days.**

Built for £5m–£100m turnover Outcome-accountable Direct senior delivery
Revenue inAt speed & scale Value outTo customers, at speed & scale

The faster **value flows out** to your customers — at speed and scale — the faster **revenue flows
in**.

The Warning Signs

## Are you working harder than your revenue reflects?

The cause is rarely effort — it’s how the business is wired. When the parts don’t connect, share
data or carry clear ownership, value leaks at every handoff. Below are the symptoms you feel day to
day. Each is a clue; none is the cause.

### Revenue Leakage

Money is lost at every stage of the journey — silently, with no clear owner.

### Missed Opportunities

Prospects fall through the cracks. No follow-up, no system; the process wins.

### Slow Response Times

Leads go cold in hours, customers wait days. The fastest business wins.

### Poor Visibility

You cannot manage what you cannot see. Untrusted data misdirects decisions.

### Weak Accountability

Activity happens without outcomes. No owner, no consequence, no improvement.

### Customer Churn

Customers leave quietly — nobody watched the signals that warned you.

### Technology Debt

Disconnected systems create duplication, delay and cost at every handoff.

### Founder Dependency

Growth stalls when it depends on one person, not a repeatable system.

### Sales-Led Imbalance

Acquisition outpaces delivery and retention — won at the front, lost at the back.

### Slow Growth

Underperformance compounds. Harder work, smaller returns, no clear why.

The connected system

## One connected system — from first contact to repeat business.

Every stage measured, every layer owned, every handoff governed — so the business performs the same
whether or not any one person is in the room.

### Demand & Lead Generation

Websites, SEO, paid ads, social and outreach — inbound and outbound demand that fills the funnel
with the right leads, not just traffic.

### Revenue Operations (RevOps)

Marketing, sales and customer success aligned around one funnel, one dataset and shared targets —
pipeline, forecasting, attribution, conversion and retention run as one accountable system, not
siloed metrics that hide the leaks.

# Own your software.

HubSpot starts free but scales to thousands per month quickly once you need marketing automation,

### Frequently Asked Questions
* ###### What is Zigpoll?
  
  Zigpoll is a contextual micro-survey tool. The idea is that you create small interactive surveys
  that show up where and when you want them on your website. The data you gather from surveys polls
  can then be used for lots of different things, like making your business better, increasing your
  conversion rate, and generating new leads.
* ###### How is Zigpoll different from Hotjar or other survey tools?
  
  Zigpoll is built specifically for eCommerce. We integrate directly with Shopify, trigger surveys
  based on purchase events, and connect your responses to actual customer data — not anonymous
  visitors. This means you can tie feedback directly to order value, customer segments, and lifetime
  value.
* ###### Will this slow down my site?
  
  No. Our script is under 20KB and loads asynchronously. It won't affect your Core Web Vitals or
  page speed scores.
* ###### What's included in the free plan?
  
  Zigpoll Lite is free forever and includes unlimited surveys, up to 100 responses per month, all
  question types, basic integrations, and email support. No credit card required to start. You can
  upgrade anytime to unlock unlimited responses, advanced integrations, and AI-powered insights.
* ###### Can I have multiple surveys on my website?
  
  Yes. You can have as many surveys as you want on your website. You can only show one survey per
  page though.
* ###### Can I put a specific survey on a specific page of my website?
  
  Yes. You can specify what pages you want a survey to show up on using our Page Rules. You can
  exclude certain pages, or match certain pages based on a variety of options. If you have trouble
  getting a survey on a certain page, email us and we'll be happy to help: [[email protected]][51].
* ###### Does this work for all websites?
  
  Yes. All you need to do is copy the embed code and place it within the head tag of your website
  and you will be all set. If you need help putting the code in, we are always here to help, just
  send us an email here: [[email protected]][52].
* ###### Can I customize my Zigpoll?
  
  Yes. You can change all the colors of your Zigpoll using the display tab. Each survey can have a
  different color scheme if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize when my Zigpoll shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control where and when the survey shows up using the visibility tab. You can control
  each survey separately or all of them in bulk if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize how many times the survey shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control how many times a user sees a survey using the visibility tab. You can also
  control if the survey hides immediately or if it continues to show up after it has been completed.
* ###### Can I get in touch with you for custom support?
  
  Absolutely! We pride ourselves on having world class support. Send an email to
  [[email protected]][53] or use our [contact form][54] and we will get in touch ASAP no matter what
  plan you are on or your request.
